meta.name: docusign-automation
meta.description: Automate DocuSign tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): templates, envelopes, signatures, document management. Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动完成 DocuSign 模板、信封与签名流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要批量处理 DocuSign 签署任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate DocuSign templates, envelopes, and signatures
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently handle DocuSign signing tasks in bulk

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 Rube MCP 自动执行 DocuSign 任务：列出模板、创建并发送信封、监控签署状态、管理信封生命周期。
howto.when: 当你要求处理 DocuSign 电子签名流程时触发，例如查找模板、发送文件请求签名、检查签署进度。

say.text: 帮我列出所有 DocuSign 模板。
say.note: Claude 会调用工具列出模板。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate DocuSign tasks via Rube MCP: list templates, create and send envelopes, monitor signing status, and manage envelope lifecycle.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to handle DocuSign e-signature workflows, such as finding templates, sending documents for signature, or checking signing progress.

say_en.note: Claude will call the tool to list templates.

say_en.text: Create an envelope from template 'Contract Template' for John (john@example.com).
say_en.note: Claude will create and send the envelope.
Claude will query the envelope's current status.
